To troubleshoot your current setup and identify the root cause, please verify the following:Status update: How is the system behaving right now?


Are there any new error codes or symptoms? Timeout Settings: Increase the mail news.tcp-timeout value in the config editor. This often resolves connection drops.

Server Configuration: Verify your incoming/outgoing server settings.

Ensure a recent update didn't reset your ports or authentication methods. Security Software: Temporarily turn off your VPN and antivirus (including live email scanning).

Add a dedicated exception rule for Thunderbird in your firewall/antivirus scanner.Network Reset: Power cycle your router by disconnecting the power cable for 30 seconds.
